result.title: Self-prediction residuals improve single-pass detection of wrong-object boxes in grounded vision-language models
result.comment: 35 pages, 5 figures; supplementary material included (65 pages). Code: https://github.com/chen4study-hub/spred
result.summary: Grounded vision-language models write boxes as text, and the mean probability of their coordinate tokens says little about whether a box is right. We study a single-pass signal for boxes on another object, which matter when only the object counts. A linear map, fitted per model to its own answers without labels, reads a box from the hidden state before writing. Its disagreement with the written box, the self-prediction residual, flags boxes on another object although the read-out is far less accurate; the residual's weight was fixed with labels on two models. On a replication list of 1,200 RefCOCOg test items, the residual, averaged over six models, raises the detection of these errors for each of fifteen single-pass scores, by 0.026 to 0.049 in area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) on a label-free probe and probes trained on 2,000 labelled items. Over all errors, adding it to the label-free probe moves AUROC, averaged over the models, by less than 0.02 (95% interval). With a fifth of answers reviewed, the share of all errors caught moves from 0.518 to 0.524, that of boxes on another object from 0.505 to 0.607 (post hoc): the residual changes which errors are found, not how many, and in cost-weighted recall it breaks even when such a box costs about 0.86 times another error, and its gain is positive in point estimate at equal costs. These gains come from RefCOCOg lists of MS-COCO images.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究在 grounded VLM 中，用写框前隐状态经固定线性映射读出框，并以该读出与写出框的不一致作为 self-prediction residual，单遍检测落在其他物体上的错误框，并在 RefCOCOg 上跨多个模型评估其增益。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接涉及 VLM 内部状态是否保留任务必要的物体与视觉证据，以及答案是否使用 latent 内容；该残差可供核查视觉证据筛选、错误检测与有限复核预算下的停止决策，但需确认其捕获的是错误对象而非一般错误。
